job.label: Whisper SMG — Fine
job.prompt:
Create the Fine-finish cosmetic variant of the attached fictional RPG Whisper submachine gun inventory painting for Project Heaven Cry. This is a 2D digital game-art asset. FIRST attachment fixes the exact visible Standard geometry and registration: preserve its complete outline, all parts and openings, proportions, pose, camera, scale and margins. SECOND attachment supplies Heavenprint ink and gouache brushwork only, never a person or scene.

Grade: Fine. The same gun, refinished. An even, unscratched finish on the slide or receiver, its edges and the muzzle crown bright; the grip panels or stock clean; moving parts look freshly oiled. Add one thin engraved line along the side of the slide or receiver, following its top edge. Nothing else is added.

Keep the original long dark front cylinder with its dark opening, angular small receiver, open metal rear stock with its small slate-blue plate and rivets, original separate grip and trigger-guard opening, and original angled rectangular lower magazine at its exact position and length. Preserve every sight, vent, band, seam and pin. Original slate-blue plate stays in place, no new colour. One thin uncoloured engraved line on the existing receiver side following its top edge; even clean metal, unchanged dark parts. Apply those surface changes only to the actual object shown. No new coloured inlay, ornament or repair at Fine. Do not add, remove, resize or move a part or opening. Hand-painted opaque gouache and ink, broken directional strokes and selective dry-brush, charcoal shadows, warm ivory focal edges, upper-left light. Full transparent background,1024x1024RGBA, same framing and at least50px clear margin. No cast shadow, ground, scene, figure, hand, text, letters, numbers, logos, labels, frame, border, flash, smoke or external glow. Exterior painted illustration only, no technical diagram, internal mechanism, measurements, assembly steps or operating instructions.
job.keep_line: the same compact dark angular suppressed submachine gun pointing up-right, one long fat plain suppressor with a dark circular end, small receiver with short top rail and low sights, straight slightly slanted magazine below and ahead of the grip, separate pistol grip and rectangular trigger guard, short angular rear stock with a small riveted blue-grey side plate. Preserve suppressor length/diameter, muzzle opening, magazine angle, grip/guard opening, stock shape, rivets, sights and exactly the small blue-grey stock plate. No second magazine or new ports, no muzzle light.
